records.title: KOSS: Kalman-Optimal Selective State Spaces for Long-Term Sequence Modeling
records.reason: KOSS formulates state selection via Kalman gain and uses spectral differentiation plus segment-wise scans; it reports copying and long-horizon forecasting gains, including near-linear hardware-oriented processing. Its evaluations are time-series/radar rather than LLMs; the SSM alternative is a plausible architecture relation but LLM inference benefit is not tested.

records.title: Distillation of Discrete Diffusion by Exact Conditional Distribution Matching
records.reason: The method distills discrete diffusion samplers by matching conditional distributions to one- or few-step students, targeting fewer function evaluations. It is a plausible text-generation acceleration method if applied to language diffusion, but the paper’s scope/evaluation does not establish an LLM-serving improvement.

records.title: NRR-Core: Non-Resolution Reasoning as a Computational Framework for Contextual Identity and Ambiguity Preservation
records.reason: NRR-Core specifies contextual retention and non-resolution operators and tests one gated multi-vector embedding on a synthetic two-turn ambiguity task. The paper proposes non-collapsing attention as an implementation direction but does not evaluate long-context LLM memory, sparse attention, or serving costs.

records.title: Large Visual Language Models Continual Learning With Dynamic Mixture of Experts
records.reason: IEEE DOI https://doi.org/10.1109/TIP.2025.3639925 opened only a robot-verification/JavaScript page. Abstract describes continual-learning MoE for visual-language models; primary methods/evaluation and inference efficiency are unavailable.

records.title: GPMassSimulator: A Graphormer-Based Method for Glycopeptide MS/MS Spectra Prediction.
records.reason: Primary ACS DOI https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.analchem.5c02375 was inaccessible. Abstract concerns glycopeptide MS/MS prediction by Graphormer; the speculative-decoding lineage relation could not be checked in full text.
